projections.method: In-memory TypeScript transpileModule ES2022/ESNext; parse actual and expected JavaScript; compare removeComments printer-normalized full AST. No audited module evaluated, no build invoked, no output emitted to dist.
limits: Static AST projection, not execution or whole-program semantic equivalence
Comments, source-map location and formatting are excluded from AST comparison but included in compiled byte pins
ESNext module projection used to compare emitted syntax, not proof of NodeNext module resolution
Another writer may rebuild; rehash actual candidate and compare again before activation
